args.title: Fix password reset email link base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the base URL used in password reset emails from a hardcoded localhost fallback to a more appropriate configuration or environment variable setting. This improves the password reset link to correctly point to the production or deployment environment instead of localhost, which is inaccessible for users outside the development environment.
